title: Quantum-Resilient Signature: Lightweight LWE-Based Authentication and Signatures for Blockchain Transactions
description: Code and data behind an experimental comparison of two lightweight lattice-based designs for blockchain-style workloads. Track A is a symmetric LWE-based authentication tag whose matrix is derived from each transaction hash; Track B is a Lyubashevsky-style public-key lattice signature built with Fiat-Shamir with aborts. The repository contains correctness tests, timing comparisons against RSA-3072-PSS, scaled-down LLL embedding attacks used to cross-check the estimated security levels, a small blockchain workload simulation, and an independent cross-check against the community lattice-estimator. Security figures are parameter estimates for research prototypes, not formal proofs; details are in docs/. The study is also available as a preprint in the Cryptology ePrint Archive, Paper 2026/1925 (https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1925). Developed with AI-assisted coding and writing tools; all experiments, numbers, and conclusions were reviewed and verified by the author.
